allocation_scope: ordinary C++ new on calling thread; excludes C malloc/aligned and worker allocations
combined: sum of measured preparation, kernel for all physical roots and partialDot; excludes fixture setup/digest creation and comparisons
derived_fields_provenance: Throughput/absolute/percent values are computed from this run's recorded coordinates and times. Raw measured fields remain unchanged; kernel-evidence/R7_OPT3A_KERNEL_BENCHMARK.json preserves the original remote JSON.
RSS_scope: Combined-process cumulative peak with both reference/candidate caches, not separately attributable old/new RSS.
Fr_operation_scope: Fr operator invocation counts in kernel+partial only; excludes prepare bias, weight precomputation, Sumcheck/MSM. Reference multiply/add counts derive from measured matched coordinates and preserved exact reference loop (2mul+1add kernel;3mul+1add partial). Not CPU instruction counts.
